ticket.title: outfeed install resolves the crate path relative to cwd, so running it inside a member repo fails
acceptance_criteria: DONE 2026-11-06 (outfeed commit). outfeed_core::install::discover_suite_root walks ancestors until every SUITE_TOOLS repository has a Cargo.toml

and the CLI uses it when --dir is absent. An explicit --dir is still honoured verbatim.\n\nVerified from the failing position rather than a convenient one: 'cd benchwork && outfeed install benchwork --debug' now resolves the crate path and reports 'up-to-date by version; pass --force to rebuild from source' (exit 0) instead of 'Crate path does not exist: ./benchwork/crates/benchwork-cli' (exit 1 with the old binary left in place). Tier 2: fmt clean
outfeed-core tests green.\n\nWhy it mattered beyond the error: the failure was quiet about the important part. Exit 1 said the path was wrong; nothing said the binary had not changed
so the natural next step was to retry the command rather than to notice the build never happened.
